about: Claude Code's shot-by-shot judgment of halloween-clowns-sf (2026-09-25), made independently of the director from six frames per clip, as labels for benchmarking the director's review without rendering. should_redo = the shot misses a key element of the brief or its own line badly enough that a retake is worth its render time. The human's eye is the final judge; these are one reviewer's labels.

scores_of_the_run: The director agreed with every strong shot it kept, kept both misses (1, 3) and every partial including the should-redo ones (4, 7), and asked to redo two strong shots (2 take 1, 12 take 1). It never compared a character across shots.
